nodes.description: Commission fee percentage (default 5) written by setCommisionPercentage and read in valueTransfer.
Mapping string nft key to required bid price, written by setVaultData and read by claim functions.
Index pointer into claims mapping, incremented by each claim call.
Mapping of claimId to Claim struct holding bidder, nft contract, owner, tokenId, value, amount, data and fulfilled flag.
Owner address of the contract, used for onlyOwner access control and as commission receiver.
onlyOwner function that sets the expected bid price for a given nft key.
onlyOwner function that sets commisionFeesPercentage.
Payable nonReentrant function that records an ERC721 claim after validating msg.value against the vault price.
Payable nonReentrant function that records an ERC1155 claim with amount and data after validating msg.value.
onlyOwner function that transfers the NFT to the bidder via IERC1155/IERC721 external calls and then pays the seller.
onlyOwner function that refunds the bidder using address.transfer on the stored value.
Internal function computing and splitting the commission between the seller and the owner using SafeMath and Address.sendValue.
onlyOwner payable function that forwards an arbitrary amount to a caller-supplied receiver via transfer.
Returns the current owner address; used both for access control and as commission recipient.
Caller-controlled address, used for authorization checks and recorded as the claim sender.
Arithmetic combination computing the commission fee from value and commisionFeesPercentage.
Low-level value transfer with call{value:} to the seller and the owner, an external call sink.
address.transfer of the stored bid value to the recorded bidder inside rejectSale.
address.transfer of an owner-chosen amount to an owner-chosen receiver.
External callback-capable ERC1155 safe transfer to the bidder in approveSale.
External ERC721 transfer initiated from approveSale.
NFT key used as the vault mapping key in setVaultData.

New commission percentage assigned in setCommisionPercentage.

Arbitrary calldata forwarded on the ERC1155 safe transfer.

Claim index selected for refund.
Recipient of the value minus commission in valueTransfer.
Value to be split into commission and seller payment.
